description: Read-only preview of moving free cash straight from one venue to another (Hyperliquid, Polymarket, Lighter), like Transfer in the Felix app: free cash on the source, the minimum, the route (front: the destination is funded at once from the Trading wallet; chain: through the Trading wallet) and an ETA in seconds. Omit amount_usd to preview all free cash. Open orders, positions and running agents keep their cash. Creates, reserves and signs nothing.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID. Omit for the active account.

amount_usd.description: USDC amount, at most six decimal places. Omit to preview all free cash.

name: preview_venue_transfer
